content.value_statement: Generative art requests can become vague sketches without a strong computational concept. This skill turns themes into seeded p5.js artworks with parameters, controls, and browser-ready presentation.
actual_capabilities: Creates a concise algorithmic philosophy before implementation.
Guides p5.js artwork with seeded randomness and noise fields.
Uses an HTML viewer template with seed navigation and controls.
Defines adjustable parameters through sliders and color pickers.
Supports reproducible seed variations for exploration and sharing.
Includes a JavaScript reference template for common p5.js structure.
limitations: The viewer template loads p5.js and fonts from external CDNs by default.
The templates are starting points and include placeholder algorithm sections.
Output quality depends on the model implementing the final artwork.
Very complex animations may need performance tuning in the browser.

use_cases.title: Concept Art Exploration
use_cases.description: Turn a theme, mood, or reference into an interactive generative artwork.

use_cases.title: Creative Coding Prototypes
use_cases.description: Build a seeded p5.js sketch with parameters for fast iteration.

use_cases.title: Teaching Generative Systems
use_cases.description: Demonstrate how rules, randomness, and parameters create emergent visuals.

prompt_templates.title: Start A Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a complete artwork concept.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an interactive generative artwork from this theme: [theme]. Include an algorithmic philosophy and a seeded p5.js HTML viewer.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Parameters
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for controls and exploration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a p5.js generative artwork about [concept]. Add meaningful sliders, seed navigation, color controls, reset, and download support.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a seeded generative art series for [subject]. Define the core algorithm, then identify strong seed ranges for 100 variations.

prompt_templates.title: Refine A Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using an existing direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this philosophy and visual goal: [details]. Implement a polished p5.js artifact with optimized performance and precise parameter behavior.

output_examples.input: Create generative art about tidal memory.
output_examples.output: A philosophy named Tidal Memory and an interactive viewer with flowing particles, reproducible seeds, and adjustable current strength.

output_examples.input: Make gallery variations based on urban airflow.
output: A computational concept about invisible city currents.
A browser-ready artwork with seed navigation and density controls.
Suggested seed ranges for comparing calm, turbulent, and layered compositions.

output_examples.input: Turn a product launch theme into abstract motion art.
output_examples.output: A branded generative sketch concept with parameter controls for energy, contrast, motion speed, and color balance.

best_practices: Start with a clear theme and let the philosophy guide the algorithm.
Use seeds for every random decision so results are reproducible.
Test the HTML artifact in a browser and tune controls for useful ranges.
anti_patterns: Do not copy a specific artist, living creator, or known artwork.
Do not replace the viewer structure before reading the template.
Do not add extra external libraries unless the user approves them.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates an algorithmic art concept and a p5.js HTML viewer for interactive exploration.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can I choose my own theme?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed to interpret user themes into computational art systems.

faq.question: Does it produce finished image files?
faq.answer: It focuses on interactive HTML artifacts. The template includes support for downloading a PNG from the canvas.

faq.question: Does the viewer require internet access?
faq.answer: By default, it loads p5.js and fonts from external CDNs. Authors can bundle these assets locally.

faq.question: Is every seed reproducible?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the implementation to seed p5.js random and noise functions for repeatable output.
